info.title: Lidifin Mobile API
info.description: Complete API reference for the Lidifin backend. All paths are relative to /api. Primary authentication is username/password via JWT access + refresh tokens; API keys and session cookies are also accepted on most endpoints. Some endpoints require admin privileges (noted in their description). A curated subset of core mobile flows carries fully detailed request/response schemas; remaining endpoints document path, method, auth, and parameters.

bearerAuth.description: Primary mobile authentication. Obtain with POST /auth/login and refresh with POST /auth/refresh.

apiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
apiKeyAuth.description: Secondary device authentication for paired devices and integrations.

streamTokenAuth.name: token
streamTokenAuth.description: Optional query token for stream URLs when attaching Authorization headers is inconvenient.

sessionAuth.name: connect.sid
sessionAuth.description: Web UI session authentication. Included for completeness.

MediaProgress.description: Per-user playback progress. Null when the item has never been played.

coverUrl.description: Relative path (e.g. /audiobooks/{id}/cover) or null when no cover exists.

chapters.description: Chapter markers as returned by Audiobookshelf.

audioFiles.description: Audio file descriptors as returned by Audiobookshelf.

coverUrl.description: Relative path (e.g. /podcasts/{id}/cover) or the original RSS image URL.

episodes.description: Latest episodes (up to 5 on the library list).

RadioTrack.description: Track shape returned by radio/mix endpoints. Note artist is top-level (not nested under album as in TrackSummary).

audioFeatures.description: Only present on vibe-type radio responses.

track.description: Resolved track; null if the track could not be resolved.

mergedItems.description: Resolved items and pending tracks merged and sorted by position.

post.description: Primary mobile authentication flow. Returns JWT access and refresh tokens. If two-factor auth is enabled and no second factor is provided, the response indicates that 2FA is required.

token.description: Optional TOTP or recovery code when 2FA is enabled

200.description: Login successful, or second-factor confirmation required

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token and refresh token pair.
Creates a long-lived API key for paired devices or integrations. This is not the primary mobile sign-in flow.

post.summary: Generate a short-lived device link code
post.description: Optional secondary pairing flow for clients that should link to an already authenticated account.

post.summary: Exchange a device link code for an API key

get.summary: Poll the status of a device link code

get.description: Streams a native or Jellyfin-backed track. Supports HTTP Range requests for seeking. Bearer JWT is the primary mobile auth mechanism.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Track ID. Can be a Prisma track ID or a jellyfin:-prefixed track ID.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Optional JWT query token for streaming contexts

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Standard HTTP Range header for seek/resume requests

206.description: Partial content response for Range requests

get.description: Returns the cached audiobook library with per-user progress. Audiobooks are backed by an external Audiobookshelf server. When Audiobookshelf is not configured, the response is an object { configured: false, enabled: false, audiobooks: [] } instead of an array.
Searches the configured Audiobookshelf server. Returns an empty array when Audiobookshelf is disabled.
Returns a single audiobook with chapters, audio files, and per-user progress.
Returns the cover image bytes (served from local cache or proxied from Audiobookshelf). No authentication is required for this endpoint.
Proxies the audiobook audio with authentication. Supports HTTP Range requests for seeking.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Standard HTTP Range header for seek/resume requests

206.description: Partial content response for Range requests

get.description: Returns the user's podcast subscriptions, each including up to 5 of its latest episodes with per-user progress.

post.description: Subscribe by RSS feed URL or by iTunes collection ID. At least one of feedUrl or itunesId is required.

get.description: Episodes from subscribed podcasts published within the last 14 days that are less than 1% played.
Episodes with playback progress between 1% and 100%, ordered by publish date.
Returns popular podcasts sourced from iTunes for discovery/subscription. Results are external (not yet subscribed) and carry an itunesId/feedUrl for use with POST /podcasts/subscribe.
Returns a subscribed podcast with its full episode list and per-user progress. Returns 404 if the user is not subscribed to this podcast.

404.description: Podcast not found or not subscribed

get.description: Streams an episode from local cache or the source RSS URL. Supports HTTP Range requests for seeking; episodes are auto-cached in the background for better seek support.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Standard HTTP Range header for seek/resume requests

206.description: Partial content response for Range requests

get.summary: Get tracks for a radio station
get.description: Builds a station queue of tracks for the given station type. For vibe-type requests the response also includes a sourceFeatures object and tracks carry an audioFeatures field.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Station value depending on type: e.g. a decade start year (1990), a genre or mood name, an artist ID for type=artist, or a source track ID for type=vibe.

400.description: Missing/invalid radio type or required value

get.description: Returns genres in the library (with track counts) used to build genre radio stations.
Returns decades represented in the library (with track counts) used to build decade radio stations.
Returns aggregate Last.fm mood-tag counts used to build vibe radio stations. Cached server-side for 6 hours.
Reports whether the optional AudioMuse-AI service is configured and reachable. Clients should hide the AI-powered radio section unless both enabled and available are true.

post.description: Generates a playlist from a mood or free-text prompt via AudioMuse-AI. Requires Jellyfin as the music source. This call can take a long time (the AI workflow may run up to ~2-3 minutes); use a long client timeout. Provide either mood or userInput.

userInput.description: Free-text prompt describing the desired vibe.

200.description: Playlist generated (may be empty with a message)

400.description: Missing prompt or Jellyfin not configured

get.summary: Get tracks similar to a track (Similar Song radio)
get.description: Returns tracks acoustically similar to the given track via AudioMuse-AI. Requires Jellyfin; trackId must be a jellyfin:-prefixed ID.

400.description: Missing/invalid trackId or Jellyfin not configured

get.summary: Get artists similar to an artist (Artist Similarity)
get.description: Returns artists similar to the given artist via AudioMuse-AI. Provide either artistId or artist (name). Requires Jellyfin.

400.description: Missing artist identifier or Jellyfin not configured

get.summary: Get tracks for an artist (for similarity playlists)
get.description: Returns tracks for a given artist, used to build playlists from similar artists. Provide either artistId or artist (name). Requires Jellyfin.

400.description: Missing artist identifier or Jellyfin not configured

post.description: Builds a curated playlist by adding and subtracting songs/artists via AudioMuse-AI. Requires Jellyfin.

400.description: Missing items or Jellyfin not configured

post.description: Persists a generated playlist (e.g. from instant/alchemy/similar) to Jellyfin via AudioMuse-AI. Requires Jellyfin.

400.description: Missing name/trackIds or Jellyfin not configured

get.description: Returns the user's playlists plus any public playlists. Track lists are not included here (use GET /playlists/{id}); each entry carries a trackCount. When Jellyfin is enabled, playlists are reconciled from Jellyfin on this call.

post.description: Creates a new playlist. When Jellyfin is enabled, the playlist is also created in Jellyfin.

get.description: Returns a playlist with its resolved track items (and any pending Spotify-import tracks). Access is denied for private playlists owned by another user.

put.description: Renames a playlist or toggles its visibility. Owner only. At least one field is required.

delete.description: Deletes a playlist owned by the user.

get.description: Returns an SVG cover generated from the playlist's first track covers.

post.summary: Add a track to a playlist
post.description: Appends a track to the playlist. trackId may be a native track ID or a jellyfin:-prefixed ID. Owner only.

delete.summary: Remove a track from a playlist

put.description: Sets the playlist's track order to the provided array of track IDs. Owner only.

trackIds.description: Track IDs in the desired order.
